rationale: Create one ChillCo cold-chain platform record under Igneo Infrastructure Partners. Igneo identifies a March 2026 initial acquisition and sole governance, and its April 1 announcement and ChillCo's launch release establish Mattingly Cold Storage as the anchor operating brand beneath the platform rather than a separate PortCo. The exact legal entity, fund, vehicle, ownership percentage and legal closing day are not publicly disclosed, and no later ownership change or exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

afterImage.name: ChillCo
afterImage.description: ChillCo is a U.S. cold-chain warehousing and logistics platform serving food producers, distributors and retailers with frozen, refrigerated and dry storage, blast freezing and thawing, picking, sorting, reboxing, palletizing, labeling, EDI and related third-party logistics services. Igneo Infrastructure Partners established the platform through the acquisition of Mattingly Cold Storage, its 275,000-square-foot Zanesville, Ohio anchor facility with more than 30,000 pallet positions. Igneo's asset metadata identifies March 2026 as the initial acquisition and sole governance, while the April 1, 2026 launch materials describe Mattingly as a retained operating brand beneath ChillCo. The exact legal holdco, fund, vehicle, ownership percentage and legal close day are not publicly disclosed. No later add-on, new facility, ownership change, recapitalization, exit or signed pending transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
